description:
Other polygons for Flood, Mozambique, 12 January 2015 (FL20150112MOZ): 8 features merged from 8 source layers. Polygons layers that match none of the named groups. The source layer names below say what each holds. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Geodata of Flood Water over Namacura and Maganja Da Costa District, Zambezia Province, Mozambique](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-flood-water-over-namacura-and-maganja-da-costa-district-zambezia-p-february-10-2015)
- [Geodata of Flood Waters In Zambezia, Tete and Sofala, Mozambique, and Southern Region, Malawi](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-flood-waters-in-zambezia-tete-and-sofala-mozambique-and-southern-r-february-02-2015)
- [Geodata of Flood Waters In Zambezia, Tete and Sofala, Mozambique, and Southern Region, Malawi](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-flood-waters-in-zambezia-tete-and-sofala-mozambique-and-southern-r-february-04-2015)
- [Geodata of Flood Waters In Zambezia, Tete and Sofala, Mozambique, and Southern Region, Malawi](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-flood-waters-in-zambezia-tete-and-sofala-mozambique-and-southern-r-february-16-2015)
- [Geodata of Flood Waters Over Zambezia Province, Mozambique](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-flood-waters-over-zambezia-province-mozambique-january-19-2015)
- [Geodata of Flood Waters Over Zambezia, Tete and Sofala Provinces, Mozambique](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-flood-waters-over-zambezia-tete-and-sofala-provinces-mozambique-january-21-2015)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
